title: Site Engineer
screening_questions: Which of the following statements best describes your right to work in Australia?
How many years' experience do you have as a site engineer?
Have you completed a qualification in engineering?
Are you willing to undergo pre-employment drug and alcohol screening?
Do you have a current Police Check (National Police Certificate) for employment?
How much notice are you required to give your current employer?
Are you willing to undergo a pre-employment medical check?
Are you a current member of Engineers Australia?
Do you have Engineering Drawing Interpretation experience?
rationale: Site Engineer working under senior engineers on civil, defence and infrastructure projects: site coordination, progress reporting and site records match Marc's Philippines field engineer and project-in-charge work.
AutoCAD and reading technical drawings are listed and are in Marc's Advanced Diploma; civil exposure is desirable, not essential.
Cairns, not FIFO, so relocation would be needed; advert asks for 2 to 5 years industry experience and an Engineers Australia accredited degree.
caution: Experience ask (2 to 5 years) is above Marc's roughly 10 months of site work; Philippine BSCE accreditation by Engineers Australia not confirmed; Defence Common Access Card eligibility not confirmed for a 485 visa holder.
gaps: Cairns relocation for Marc to confirm
mandatory_unresolved: Engineers Australia accredited engineering degree (transcripts required at interview)
Eligibility to obtain a Defence Common Access Card (DCAC) on a 485 visa
